scenario.title: Battle of Rimini
intro.text:
BATTLE OF RIMINI - 15 SEP 1944

South of Conca River, Italy

The Germans retreated behind the Conca River and established a new defensive line there. Break through that line, advance on Rimini and free the city!

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE A bomber squadron, trained and equipped by our British Allies, is subject to your command. Congratulations!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-15-0-briliant.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.reaction-15-0-briliant.text: The Foglia positions broke and the brigade reached the Rimini approaches with its battalions still coherent. The first official reports already use the word exemplary.
line.reaction-15-1-victory-tactical.text: The required ground was secured, though several ridge positions held until the final phase. Canadian headquarters now knows the brigade can be relied upon—and directed.
line.callback-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.callback-0.text: The brigade reached the Foglia objectives before Allied liaison found our arrow. The men took it as proof that trust suits them better than supervision.
line.callback-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.callback-1.text: Supply never lost the brigade on the Foglia. Since then Allied headquarters has assumed Greek timetables will fit British priorities. Reliability collects its own debts.
line.scene-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.scene-0.text: You can see Rimini's towers between the shell bursts. The airfield is to the west, the port to the east, and every Canadian staff officer has drawn our arrow on a different map.
line.scene-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.scene-1.text: Mine puts you on the coast. It is less imaginative and has the virtue of sharing a road with your ammunition.
line.scene-2.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.scene-2.text: The airfield turns the city. It also puts Greek battalions beyond the timetable Hale can protect. Commander?
line.decision.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.decision.text: We can envelop through the airfield or advance beside the coast. Which risk belongs to the brigade?
line.decision.choice.turn-through-the-ai: Use engineers and reconnaissance to envelop Rimini through the airfield.
Give infantry and reconnaissance 15 experience and fully refuel the core.
line.decision.choice.advance-on-the-coas: Keep the brigade on the coastal road and take the port sector in sequence.
Give artillery 15 experience, restore the core to at least eight strength, and fully rearm it.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.choice-a-0.text: I object. Not because the turn is unsound—because the support plan ends where your arrow bends.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.choice-a-1.text: Objection recorded. Engineers take the airfield, reconnaissance turns at once, and the batteries displace before the Canadians have time to ask whose timetable won.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.choice-b-0.text: Very well. We stay on the recognised road. If the Germans leave the western approach open, I reserve the right to be annoyed by our good logistics.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.choice-b-1.text: You may be annoyed in Rimini. Port sector first, batteries by phase line, and no battalion crosses the Canadian boundary chasing a rear guard.
